prompts.name: 01-ivory-minimal
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity Android mobile app visual design concept for the user's existing Routine App habit tracker.
Create ONE beautiful complete portrait Today screen, straight-on flat screenshot, tall 2:3 canvas, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outer poster or collage, no watermark. This is a usable native mobile interface, readable at actual phone scale. Respect Android status bar and bottom gesture safe areas. Use a disciplined 8-point spacing system, large touch targets, restrained outline icons, exceptionally crisp typography, realistic mobile content density. Keep every element on canvas. Content in English, matching this existing app.
Actual app features: daily and weekly habits, count goals, timed focus, completion, busy-day goals, schedule and progress. Avoid introducing social feeds, AI coaches, payment offers, login, photography or portraits.
Use exactly four bottom navigation items with icons and labels: "Today", "Schedule", "Progress", "Profile"; Today selected.
Screen data: header "Today", subtitle "Saturday, October 31". Seven-day strip Mon 26, Tue 27, Wed 28, Thu 29, Fri 30, Sat 31, Sun 1; highlight Sat 31. Compact daily completion summary "2 of 5 completed", "3 remaining", "40%" with a mathematically correct 40% progress indicator. Section "Your habits" with compact "Busy day" pill and filter icon. Show three pending habit cards, each with one clear primary action and a small overflow menu: "Drink water", "2 of 8 glasses", "+1", water-drop icon and 8-segment progress with exactly 2 segments filled; "Read a book", "0 of 20 min", "10:00 AM", "Start" with play icon; "Plan tomorrow", "5 min", "8:00 PM", unchecked completion control. "Read a book" can have a small "Up next" label. Below, a collapsed row "Completed · 2" with check and chevron; no extra completed habit cards. Near bottom a primary "+ Add habit" button that does not overlap any content or navigation.
The design must feel calm, carefully art-directed, premium and easy to build in React Native. No unreadably tiny helper copy.
Design direction 01 / Ivory Minimal: elegant editorial clarity, warm ivory #F8F6F0 page, pure white cards, forest green #20594C accents, sage #E4EBDF icon discs, subtle amber busy-day pill. Large sophisticated dark serif word "Today", all functional text clean humanist sans serif. Generous breathing room, very thin warm-gray borders, 20px card corners, extremely subtle shadows. Date selection is a forest-green rounded rectangle. Horizontal progress bar, no redundant oversized hero. Habit title hierarchy feels balanced, restrained and modern. Aim for exquisite simplicity.

Design direction 02 / Soft Sage: a fresh, tactile, friendly premium habit tracker rooted in the app's existing forest green and sage identity. Pale sage #E4EBDF overall page, rich forest green #20594C upper summary card with high-contrast ivory text and a 40% thin ivory circular progress ring. Rounded white habit cards with 24px corners, soft understated shadows, oversized simple line icons on small pale sage tiles. Bold rounded sans-serif heading and clear restrained typography everywhere. Day strip uses compact individual pills; selected day deep green. Give the Up next reading card a delicate green border. Amber is confined to the busy-day pill. Elegant floating rounded bottom navigation panel with all four labels visible and a comfortable gesture area, and a pill-shaped Add habit button above. Balanced, touch-friendly, polished; no decorative blobs or illustrations.

Design direction 03 / Forest Dark: luxurious accessible night-mode interpretation of this app's existing dark theme. Deep matte forest #101A16 canvas, slightly lighter #192720 habit cards, fine #354C3F borders, mint #97D7B4 actions, ivory #EDF5EF main text, muted sage #AABCB0 secondary text. Warm amber #F3C573 busy-day detail. Beautiful confident sans-serif typography with a large Today header. Selected date mint with dark text. Summary is a quiet dark-sage panel with thin mint progress bar; no glow. Clear mint outline Start button and solid mint Add habit CTA with dark text. Tight consistent icon language, finely balanced spacing, 20px corners. Bottom navigation matches the matte dark surfaces, Today mint active, all four labels visible. It must feel rich and calm, without neon, glassmorphism or gradients.
